organizations.What they build: Alphabet's AI lab (HQ London). Builds the Gemini Robotics family: a vision-language-action model (VLA = a model that turns camera images + a text instruction into motor commands), an embodied-reasoning model for multi-step planning, and an on-device VLA. Gemini Robotics 2.5 (Nov 2026) reports 30-100% higher success than the previous version, tested on Apptronik's Apollo 2 humanoid and in a Mercedes-Benz factory pilot.

London-headquartered developer of end-to-end AI driving software: a learned system interprets sensor input and controls the vehicle. Its official site describes a mapless, sensor- and hardware-agnostic AI Driver and a Mercedes-Benz partnership. June 2026 reporting describes a planned London Uber robotaxi service, initially with safety operators and subject to regulatory approval, and a $1.2B February 2026 financing, with an additional $300M from Uber contingent on deployment. Its official announcements label the February financing Series D and add a $60M extension in April 2026.

Commercial AI platform and open-source community with Paris and New York connections. Its LeRobot library supports teleoperation, dataset collection, imitation/reinforcement-learning policy training and deployment; SO-101 and Reachy Mini provide accessible hardware options. LeRobot was co-founded by Rémi Cadène, who left Hugging Face in December 2025; June 2026 reporting identifies Steven Palma as its tech lead. October 2026 reporting describes Nvidia's proposed $12.9B acquisition as under DOJ scrutiny, with closing expected in H1 2027; completion is not established.
organizations.Warm contact path: Paris office; LeRobot Discord and GitHub community; LeRobot hackathon organizers

organizations.What they build: Frontier AI lab co-founded by Yann LeCun, with Paris among its locations. It develops world models that predict abstract representations of sensor data, helping an agent anticipate the consequences of actions and plan safely. Targets include industrial control, automation and robotics. March 2026 reporting confirms SBVA's €30M commitment to a seed round, alongside other investors; total round size is unknown from these opened sources.

Founded in early 2025; Reuters reports $105M raised and a June 2026 unveiling of Eno, a general-purpose robot with a wheeled base, foldable tower and human-like hands. Its May 2026 announcement introduces the proprietary GENE-26.5 foundation model and a data engine using human demonstrations, gloves and video; simulation supports development and evaluation. Targeted customer deployments were planned for the end of 2026. The company should not be treated as the sole originator of the earlier academic Genesis simulator.

Founded 2021 by Univ. of Stuttgart AI researchers. Hardware-agnostic 'robot brain' software: the Cortex foundation model takes natural-language instructions and outputs actions for arms, mobile manipulators and humanoids. Cortex 2.0 adds a world model that simulates candidate motions and scores them before acting. Raised $110M Series B (Apr 2026); April 2026 reporting names BMW, Daimler Truck, PepsiCo, Bol and Active Ants as customers.

Polish 'physical AI' for warehouse picking: its AI brain plus vision lets robot arms pick millions of different items. Zalando is rolling out up to 50 Nomagic robots across European fulfilment centres (Mar 2026), including a shoebox picker. Expanding in the US.

UK humanoid company building wheel-based industrial humanoids and the KinetIQ AI framework for fleet-level control and RL-based skill learning. Raised $152M Series A at $1.35B valuation (Jul 2026, led by Prime Movers Lab; Schaeffler, Bosch participate); total funding $270M; customer beta rollouts from Q4 2026.

Founded by former Nvidia researchers; builds a 'brain' for humanoids: low-level skills (walking, stairs, opening doors, carrying) trained in simulation with reinforcement learning, plus a higher-level model trained on human videos that picks which skill to run. Aims for one model deployable on any robot body. Raised a ~$50M Series A (Nov 2025, per press).

ETH Zurich spin-off doing end-to-end learning for dexterous manipulation (human-like robotic hands) in factories: assembly, kitting, cables, soft objects. In July 2026 introduced FLUX-mimic, a video-action model built with Black Forest Labs that learns tasks from video with far less demonstration data, deployed at Audi.

Robot-data startup founded by ex-Red Bull and Mercedes F1 engineers. Its Atlas platform records how humans and robots do real factory tasks (dedicated recording hardware + secure data platform) to train and deploy robots in production. Raised a $55M (≈€48M) seed in July 2026, described as Germany's largest; partners with Google Cloud.

Cloud infrastructure for robot learning: collect teleoperation demonstrations, curate/version datasets, train imitation and reinforcement-learning policies, and deploy/monitor them on real robots. Its SDK is open source. A November 2025 announcement describes free academic access, initially for selected universities with others potentially waitlisted; current eligibility and compute limits for 42AI are unknown. The same report confirms a $3M pre-seed led by Earlybird.
organizations.Warm contact path: Academic access enquiry via the platform; availability for 42AI is unknown

organizations.What they build: Open-source (MIT) data layer for physical AI: an SDK to log, store, query, visualize and stream multimodal robot data (cameras, point clouds, joint states) for debugging and training. Rerun Hub is the commercial catalog. Remote-first Swedish company; raised a $17M seed (Mar 2025, per press).

Robot programming software: NOVA, a robot-agnostic 'operating system' that connects digital twins/simulation (e.g. NVIDIA Isaac Sim) to real industrial robots so tasks can be designed in simulation and deployed the same day. Customers/partners reported include Volkswagen Sachsen and Schaeffler.

AI vision-and-control software MIRAI lets industrial robots adapt to changes in position, shape, lighting and reflective/transparent objects by learning from human demonstrations. Founded in Berlin by Ronnie Vuine; December 2024 reporting says the headquarters moved to San Francisco, rather than establishing a legal reorganization. Its official site still offers MIRAI; the last funding stage evidenced here is a $30M Series B announced in February 2022.

3D vision + hardware-agnostic AI software that lets existing industrial robots (FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau, Universal Robots) see part positions and correct their motions in real time. Deployed on 200+ robots in 100+ factories (Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, Bosch). Raised $12.5M in Sept 2026 (total $34M).

Lausanne robotics startup whose September 2026 funding announcement names Faber VC as lead investor, with amount undisclosed. Combines task-specific AI, teleoperation data and soft robotic hardware for factory work such as kitting and cable handling. Its official site identifies AIR/AIR01, a wheeled humanoid, and two-arm cells sharing its software stack. The company describes learning on site with human supervision; its investor dates AIR's unveiling to 6 November 2026.

Paris startup developing hardware-agnostic AI software for industrial humanoid robots. The company says an operator can teach a task in under an hour with a few demonstrations; October 2026 reporting describes as few as ten demonstrations and a goal of shortening the full deployment process to one hour. Reported €5M pre-seed co-led by Contrarian Ventures and OVNI Capital. These are company claims and targets, rather than independently measured deployment guarantees.

ETH Zurich research lab led by Marco Hutter, developing legged robots and learning-based control for challenging environments. Its work includes ANYmal and the open-source RSL-RL library, which provides GPU-friendly reinforcement-learning algorithms such as PPO for robot-learning research.
European branch (led by Fraunhofer IPA) of the ROS-Industrial consortium, which extends ROS/ROS 2 open-source software to industrial robots; runs trainings and conferences for members.
organizations.Warm contact path: Public consortium contact: opensourcerobotics@ipa.fraunhofer.de (no personal introduction established)

robots_models.Why it matters: European bet on non-humanoid general-purpose robots.

robots_models.Name: GENE-26.5
robots_models.Key specs: Proprietary robotics foundation model announced 6 May 2026; the company demonstrates long-horizon dexterous manipulation and describes training data from gloves, human demonstrations and video. Demonstrated performance is a vendor claim.
robots_models.Why it matters: Paris-made robot foundation model.

robots_models.Name: Cortex 2.0
robots_models.Key specs: The company describes a VLA augmented by a world model that generates and scores candidate movements before acting; runs across different robot hardware.
robots_models.Why it matters: Example of VLA + world-model hybrid in production logistics.

robots_models.Name: Nomagic picking robot ('Richard' at Zalando)
robots_models.Key specs: Nomagic AI picking system used at Zalando for item-level picking, scanning and sorter induction. A March 2026 release announces rollout of up to 50 systems and a separate shoebox-handling solution; this is not evidence that Richard first launched in 2026.
robots_models.Why it matters: Learned grasping at warehouse scale in Europe.

robots_models.Name: KinetIQ
robots_models.Key specs: Humanoid's proprietary multi-layer framework for orchestration of robot fleets. Its official site describes KinetIQ Ascend as enabling trial-and-error skill learning; it is a software framework rather than a single disclosed policy model.
robots_models.Why it matters: European humanoid AI stack.

robots_models.Name: FLUX-mimic
robots_models.Key specs: Video-action model developed with Black Forest Labs: a pretrained video backbone plus an action decoder, fine-tuned on robot demonstrations. A July 2026 company release reports testing and deployment with Audi; this does not establish fleet-wide production maturity.
robots_models.Why it matters: Video-pretrained action models are a frontier trend for data-efficient imitation.

robots_models.Name: Atlas (microagi)
robots_models.Key specs: Data + deployment platform; recording hardware captures task data inside live factories
robots_models.Why it matters: Shows robot data collection becoming its own business.

robots_models.Name: Neuracore platform
robots_models.Price / access: Free academic access announced November 2025; selected-university rollout and possible waitlist; current eligibility/limits unknown
robots_models.Key specs: Collect, version, train (IL/RL), deploy and monitor robot policies; open-source client tools
robots_models.Why it matters: Potential shared infrastructure for the lab; academic eligibility and compute access need confirmation.

robots_models.Name: Rerun SDK
robots_models.Key specs: Log/query/visualize multi-rate multimodal data; dataframe/SQL queries; pip install rerun-sdk
robots_models.Why it matters: Open-source tool for inspecting what a robot sensed and did, including synchronized multimodal recordings.

robots_models.Name: Wandelbots NOVA
robots_models.Key specs: Robot-agnostic OS linking digital twins/simulation to industrial robots
robots_models.Why it matters: Industrial sim-to-real programming layer.

robots_models.Name: MIRAI
robots_models.Key specs: AI vision control trained from human demonstrations; handles changes in position, shape and light, including reflective or transparent objects. The cited material does not establish a MIRAI 2 launch in 2024.
robots_models.Why it matters: Early productized learning-from-demonstration for industrial arms.

robots_models.Name: AIR (Embodied AI)
robots_models.Key specs: AIR/AIR01 is Embodied AI's wheeled humanoid with two light, tendon-driven arms. Its investor dates unveiling to 6 November 2026 and describes teleoperation followed by task learning from recorded work; autonomy claims are vendor/investor reported.
robots_models.Why it matters: Swiss entrant combining teleop data + task models.

robots_models.Key specs: GPU-accelerated robot-learning library, with PPO, SAC and student-teacher distillation; maintained in ETH RSL's leggedrobotics GitHub organization. Repository creation is dated 2021, but first release year is unknown from the opened material.
robots_models.Why it matters: Standard open RL training code for legged robots.

robots_models.Builder (if not in map): ANYbotics (commercial manufacturer; original robot developed at ETH Zurich)
robots_models.Key specs: Industrial inspection quadruped
robots_models.Why it matters: Origin platform of much European legged-RL research.

robots_models.Why it matters: Industry-standard robot software framework.

summary: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics family and Hugging Face's LeRobot illustrate complementary closed-model and open-source approaches; Wayve applies embodied AI to driving.
Opened 2026 reporting supports substantial financing for Wayve, Humanoid, Sereact, Genesis AI and microagi. AMI's cited article confirms SBVA's €30M contribution, not the asserted $1.03B total.
Company announcements document interest in factory and warehouse robot software, including Nomagic/Zalando and mimic/Audi; targets and pilots must be distinguished from completed broad rollouts.

Hypothesis assessment: the slice provides examples relevant to imitation learning, VLAs, sim-to-real and robot-data tooling. It does not establish that low-cost robot learning is the best wedge for this student lab.

Potential entry points to investigate: LeRobot's public community, Rerun's open-source SDK, Neuracore's academic programme (eligibility unknown), and technical talks with Paris robotics teams. Partnership availability is unknown.
